quotes.text: “ Table. — A broad piece of stone, brass, or the like, Hab. ii. 2 ; Luke i. 63. Such the the ancients used, to write upon, as they had no paper ; and they wished what they wrote to continue recorded to many generations. Twice God wrote his law on tables of stone. The Romans wrote their ancient laws
